title: SAPHDB: Added SAP HDB as main dissector
description:
Added the SAP HDB (HANA SQL Command Network Protocol) dissector protocol from [SecureAuth's plugin](https://github.com/SecureAuthCorp/SAP-Dissection-plug-in-for-Wireshark/blob/master/src/packet-saphdb.c).

This is a dissector that partially implements the HDB protocol. Reference of the protocol can be found in [SAP's official documentation](https://help.sap.com/viewer/7e4aba181371442d9e4395e7ff71b777/2.0.03/en-US/d5b80175490741adbf1a1ba5ec8f2695.html) and the blog series we published around the topic "Exploring the SAP HANA SQL Command Network Protocol":
- [Protocol Basics and Authentication](https://www.secureauth.com/blog/exploring-sap-hana-sql-command-network-protocol-protocol-basics-and-authentication/)
- [Password-based Authentication and TLS](https://www.secureauth.com/blog/exploring-sap-hana-sql-command-network-protocol-password-based-authentication-and-tls/)
- [Federated Authentication](https://www.secureauth.com/blog/exploring-the-sap-hana-sql-command-network-protocol-federated-authentication/)

commits_data.message:
SAPHDB: Added SAP HDB as main dissector

Added the SAP HDB (HANA SQL Command Network Protocol) dissector protocol from [SecureAuth's plugin](https://github.com/SecureAuthCorp/SAP-Dissection-plug-in-for-Wireshark/blob/master/src/packet-saphdb.c).

This is a dissector that partially implements the HDB protocol. Reference of the protocol can be found in [SAP's official documentation](https://help.sap.com/viewer/7e4aba181371442d9e4395e7ff71b777/2.0.03/en-US/d5b80175490741adbf1a1ba5ec8f2695.html) and the blog series we published around the topic "Exploring the SAP HANA SQL Command Network Protocol":
- [Protocol Basics and Authentication](https://www.secureauth.com/blog/exploring-sap-hana-sql-command-network-protocol-protocol-basics-and-authentication/)
- [Password-based Authentication and TLS](https://www.secureauth.com/blog/exploring-sap-hana-sql-command-network-protocol-password-based-authentication-and-tls/)
- [Federated Authentication](https://www.secureauth.com/blog/exploring-the-sap-hana-sql-command-network-protocol-federated-authentication/)
